text: Grabbing lunch, you crave that perfect drink. You want good value, a refreshing boost for your day.
Then you spot it: a big sign promising 'Free Refills!' A secret perk, getting more for your money without paying extra.
Your mind thinks: they must be losing money, right? Endless soda seems generous, perhaps a foolish business move.
But a soda refill's actual cost is tiny – mostly water and syrup. The real system isn't the drink; it's getting you inside.
That free refill keeps you inside longer. You're more likely to buy a snack, or return. Your perceived gain fuels their real profit.
So tomorrow, grabbing that free soda, you'll still enjoy the value. But now you see the hidden system turning your thirst into their subtle advantage.
